notes.zhScope: 一段带版本范围的实机流程视频，用于限定动物、作物、商店、NPC 对话和地图识别的观测。它是画面参考，不替代当前版本实测。
notes.use: We cite the relevant timestamp or use it to cross-check a page claim, then keep the observation tied to 0.8.10.455. We do not reproduce the creator's script, thumbnail or footage.
notes.zhUse: 本站只引用相关时间点或用它交叉核对页面结论，并把观测绑定到 0.8.10.455；不复制作者脚本、缩略图或视频画面。

notes.zhRisk: 游戏已经超出这份首发版本存档。后续版本可能改变价格、提示语和 bug 行为。

notes.name: Steam Community Guides
notes.zhName: Steam 社区指南
notes.build: Current index; individual guides vary
notes.scope: The current English most-recent view shows 8 guides: power/water production, an under-construction animal price sheet, power efficiency, opening hours, animal husbandry, crop seed/yield tests, dumpster diving and a second opening-hours guide. Direct checks still find removed or incompatible pages behind some cards, and the visible crop guide links a player Google Sheet without a verified current-build boundary. notes.zhScope: 当前英文“最新”视图显示 8 篇攻略：水电产出、施工中的动物价格表、电力效率、营业时间、动物饲养、作物种子/产量测试、翻垃圾桶赚钱以及另一份营业时间表。直查仍发现部分卡片背后的页面已移除或标记不兼容；可见作物攻略链接的玩家 Google Sheet 也没有可核实的当前版本边界。索引不会让任何攻略自动成为权威资料。
notes.use: We use a guide or linked sheet as a lead only when its version, steps and raw observation are visible. The crop sheet is kept as a research pointer, not a source for current prices, growth times or profit rankings. A claim enters a current answer only after an official response, a second independent record or a reproducible test supports it.
notes.zhUse: 只有在攻略或其外链表格显示版本、步骤和原始观测时，本站才把它当作线索。作物表只保留为研究入口，不作为当前价格、生长时间或收益排名来源。要进入当前答案，还需要官方答复、第二条独立记录或可复现实测。
notes.risk: The index can retain cards for removed pages, and surviving guides can preserve Alpha-era values or conclusions. Check the direct page, build and raw observation before using any number, opening hour or production rule; if Steam marks a page removed or incompatible, keep it as historical lead only.
notes.zhRisk: 索引可能保留已移除页面的卡片，仍存在的旧攻略也可能保留 Alpha 时代数值或结论。使用数字、营业时间或产出规则前要先打开直达页，核对版本和原始观测；Steam 标记移除或不兼容的页面只能保留为历史线索。

notes.name: Steam player feedback radar
notes.zhName: Steam 玩家反馈雷达
notes.build: Current discussion index; individual reports vary
notes.scope: The Sep 12 index showed 273 active topics, with recent titles about relationships and romance, white-looking fresh feed, a strawberry field disappearing after sleep, multiple seed-loss reports around a season transition, vehicles left near City Hall, house-collapse reports and questions about currently available features. It is a way to spot player intent and unresolved symptoms, not a game-data table.
notes.zhScope: 9 月 12 日查看时，索引显示 273 个活跃主题；近期标题包括关系与恋爱、鲜饲料发白、草莓田睡后消失、多人报告换季附近种子消失、市政厅附近停车后车辆不见、房屋坍塌和当前功能边界。它适合发现玩家意图和未解决症状，不是游戏数据表。
notes.use: We route each report to the relevant troubleshooting or guide page only after checking its date, build and any official reply. Unresolved single reports stay labeled as symptoms; they do not change map coordinates, recipes, prices or feature availability.
notes.zhUse: 本站会先核对日期、版本和官方回复，再把反馈接到对应排障页或攻略。未解决的单个报告保留为症状，不改地图坐标、配方、价格或功能可用性。
notes.risk: The index mixes languages, topics and patch states, and older threads remain visible beside current ones. Search snippets can omit the accepted answer, so the thread itself must be opened before quoting it.
notes.zhRisk: 索引混合不同语言、主题和补丁状态，旧帖也会与当前帖子并列。搜索摘要可能省略已采纳回复，引用前必须打开原帖核对。

notes.name: 0.8.10.858 solo mode and handheld behavior
notes.zhName: 0.8.10.858 单人模式与掌机行为
notes.scope: The official update says a new game or loaded save now asks the player to choose PLAY SOLO or OPEN TO FRIENDS. PLAY SOLO needs no internet connection; OPEN TO FRIENDS lets friends join and needs a stable connection. The announcement specifically calls out handheld use: a solo player can put the device to sleep and resume without losing the session because of an interrupted online connection.
notes.zhScope: 官方更新说明：新游戏或读档时会让玩家选择 PLAY SOLO 或 OPEN TO FRIENDS。PLAY SOLO 不需要联网；OPEN TO FRIENDS 允许好友加入并需要稳定网络。公告还特别说明掌机使用：单人模式下设备睡眠后可以恢复，不会因在线连接中断而丢失会话。
notes.use: Add this choice to the co-op troubleshooting path: use PLAY SOLO for offline or handheld sessions, and only select OPEN TO FRIENDS when guests need to join. Keep the distinction separate from save integrity and general network troubleshooting.
notes.zhUse: 在联机排障中明确这个选择：离线或掌机单人游玩选 PLAY SOLO，只有需要好友加入时才选 OPEN TO FRIENDS。这个模式区别要和存档完整性、一般网络排障分开。
notes.risk: The announcement does not promise that every save, loading screen or network issue is fixed. It also does not define cross-save, sleep behavior for OPEN TO FRIENDS or what happens after a hard disconnect; do not infer those rules.
notes.zhRisk: 公告没有保证所有存档、加载或网络问题都已修复，也没有说明 OPEN TO FRIENDS 的睡眠行为、跨设备存档或硬断线后的处理；不能据此推导这些规则。

notes.name: Window objective counts the window object
notes.zhName: 窗户任务统计窗户本体
notes.sourceTitle: stuck on windows on house not updating
notes.build: Early Access discussion; exact patch not stated
notes.scope: The official moderator asks whether the player crafted the actual window objects or only the wall sections with window openings. The answer confirms that the quest counts the separate window object; window walls and windows are distinct checks.
notes.zhScope: 官方版主追问玩家是否制作了独立窗户本体，而不是只建带窗开口的墙体；这确认任务统计的是独立窗户，窗墙与窗户是两项分开的检查。
notes.use: Keep the quest database wording explicit: install the window object in addition to the window-wall sections. Use this as a first check before treating a stuck window counter as a tracker bug.
notes.zhUse: 在任务数据库中明确：除窗墙外还要安装窗户本体。计数卡住时先检查是否漏装独立窗户，再按追踪器故障流程排查。
notes.risk: The reply does not give a recipe, unlock condition or placement rule, and it does not establish that every future window objective uses the same count.
notes.zhRisk: 答复没有给出配方、解锁条件或放置规则，也不能证明以后所有窗户任务都使用同样的计数方式。

notes.name: Family and generations boundary
notes.zhName: 家庭与世代边界
notes.build: Early Access discussion; exact patch not stated
notes.scope: Moderator Jennoula says players will not play as their children, while a spouse and children are described as future helpers for daily ranch duties. A follow-up comment notes that children are not implemented yet, so this thread is a boundary for planned family behavior rather than proof of a live marriage, child or inheritance system.
notes.zhScope: 版主 Jennoula 说明玩家不能扮演自己的子女，同时把配偶和子女协助日常牧场事务描述为未来的家庭方向。后续评论指出当前还没有子女功能，因此这条讨论用于划定计划中的家庭行为边界，不证明当前已实装结婚、孩子或继承系统。
notes.use: Keep the NPC database and beginner guide explicit about what is not playable: do not promise a next-generation character, child control or inheritance loop. If family systems become playable in a later official patch, replace this boundary with build-marked evidence.
notes.zhUse: 在 NPC 数据库和新手指南中明确当前不可玩的部分：不要承诺下一代角色、子女操控或继承循环。若后续官方补丁让家庭系统可玩，再用带版本号的证据替换这条边界。
notes.risk: The answer mixes a future-design description with a player comment about the current build and has no exact patch number. It does not establish marriage requirements, child timing, assistance effects or inheritance mechanics.
notes.zhRisk: 答复把未来设计描述和玩家对当前构建的评论放在一起，也没有精确补丁号；它不能证明结婚条件、生子时间、协助效果或继承机制。

notes.name: NPC gifting and Dating v2 boundary
notes.zhName: NPC 送礼与 Dating v2 边界
notes.sourceTitle: How Does the Relationship and Romance System Work?
notes.build: Early Access discussion; exact patch not stated
notes.scope: Moderator Jennoula says players can currently build relationships by equipping a gift and presenting it to an NPC. A follow-up moderator answer says preferences differ by NPC and only the first gift of the day changes the relationship, so players should test reactions rather than spam gifts. Any NPC can be befriended, but not every NPC is romanceable; Dating v2 is described as a future implementation. No universal gift-preference or romance-reward table is published.
notes.zhScope: 版主 Jennoula 说明当前可以把礼物装备在手上并交给 NPC 来积累关系。后续版主答复补充：每个 NPC 的喜好不同，每天只有第一份礼物会改变关系，因此应观察反应而不是重复刷礼物。所有 NPC 都可以先建立关系，但不是每个 NPC 都能恋爱；Dating v2 被描述为未来实装内容。官方没有公布通用的礼物喜好表或恋爱奖励表。
notes.use: Update the beginner and NPC pages with the confirmed interaction path: equip a gift, approach the NPC and use the gift action. Explain that reactions differ by NPC and only the first gift of the day counts. Keep preferences, romanceable names and rewards out of the current database until another source or a current-build reproduction supports them.
notes.zhUse: 在新手和 NPC 页面补充已确认的操作路径：装备礼物、靠近 NPC、使用赠礼操作；同时说明不同 NPC 的反应不同，且每天只有第一份礼物计入关系。喜好、可恋爱名单和奖励仍需其他来源或当前版本复现，暂不写进数据库。
notes.risk: The replies have no exact patch number and do not list preferred gifts, romanceable NPCs or rewards. The daily limit is an official answer, but it does not reveal the hidden preference values. Dating v2 is not yet implemented; old blog or wiki tables remain planning or historical leads.
notes.zhRisk: 答复没有精确补丁号，也没有列出喜欢的礼物、可恋爱 NPC 或奖励。每日限制是官方答复，但没有公开隐藏的喜好数值。Dating v2 尚未实装；旧博客或百科表格仍只能当作规划或历史线索。

notes.name: Steam review signal snapshot
notes.zhName: Steam 评测信号快照
notes.build: Current review snapshot; individual builds not stated
notes.scope: A collection snapshot recorded 50 reviews: 33 positive and 17 negative. Topic labels led with driving (10), farming (8), building (7), content (7) and quests (6), with smaller animal, co-op, controls and performance groups. The newest visible Sep 11 reviews still add negative sentiment about bug density, tutorial/dialogue clarity and driving, while early-September positive reviews frame the game as a promising Early Access project. Older samples still include missing items, crops lost after passing out and building undo/save friction.
notes.zhScope: 本轮快照记录 50 条评测：33 条好评、17 条差评。主题标签主要集中在驾驶（10）、种田（8）、建造（7）、内容（7）和任务（6），动物、联机、控制与性能主题较少。最新可见的 9 月 11 日评测仍集中反映 Bug 密度、教程/对话清晰度和驾驶体验；9 月初的好评则把它视为有潜力的抢先体验项目。更早样本仍提到物品不见、昏倒后作物丢失以及建造撤销/存档不便。
notes.use: We use the counts to prioritize which current reports and guide gaps deserve a source check. Review excerpts remain player sentiment; they do not establish a mechanic, bug rate, quest count or quality judgment for the whole game.
notes.zhUse: 本站用这些计数决定优先复核哪些当前反馈和攻略缺口。评测摘录仍是玩家感受，不能证明玩法、Bug 比例、任务总数或整款游戏的质量结论。
notes.risk: The sample is small, multilingual and time-sensitive; topic labels are collection heuristics rather than controlled categories. A review may omit its build, save state and reproduction steps, and later patches can change the signal.
notes.zhRisk: 样本量小、语言混杂且会随时间变化；主题标签是采集分类，不是控制变量。评测可能没有版本、存档和复现步骤，后续补丁也会改变信号。

notes.name: Animal food and water reserves
notes.zhName: 动物食物与水储备
notes.sourceTitle: Food and water reserves in the animal information tab
notes.build: Early Access discussion; exact patch not stated
notes.scope: A developer-moderator reply clarifies that animals eat and drink from filled troughs once per day in the morning; direct hand-feeding can raise the food reserve, while the watering can is not the matching interaction for the water reserve.
notes.zhScope: 开发商版主答复说明：动物每天早上从已填充的食槽和水槽进食饮水；靠近动物手动喂食可以增加食物储备，但浇水壶不是补水储备的对应交互。
notes.use: We use this direct answer in the animal-care guide and the feeding FAQ, keeping the exact discussion date and avoiding an invented consumption quantity or timing beyond the moderator's wording.
notes.zhUse: 本站把这条直接答复接入动物照料攻略和饲料 FAQ，保留讨论日期，不在版主没有说明的地方补写消耗数量或额外时间规则。
notes.risk: The thread does not state an exact patch number and does not prove every species-specific diet, trough placement rule or automation condition. Those fields remain tied to current-build data or separate evidence.
notes.zhRisk: 讨论没有标明精确补丁号，也不能证明每个物种的具体食物、食槽放置规则或自动化条件；这些字段仍以当前构建数据或独立证据为准。

notes.name: Animal seller purchase tab and relationship hearts
notes.zhName: 动物商人购买页与关系心形
notes.sourceTitle: Animal sellers - I can't access the purchases tab
notes.build: Early Access discussion; exact patch not stated
notes.scope: Moderator Jennoula confirms that purple hearts mean the NPC is upset and has embargoed their store. The answer also confirms that each NPC has likes and dislikes and that relationship gain from gifts applies only to the first gift of the day. The thread author reports restoring red hearts with plant-based gifts and regaining shop access; that item-specific recovery is not confirmed as a universal recipe.
notes.zhScope: 版主 Jennoula 确认紫色心形表示 NPC 不满，并会封锁其商店。答复还确认每个 NPC 都有各自的喜好与厌恶，而且每天只有第一份礼物会提升关系。发帖者报告用植物类礼物恢复红色心形并重新打开商店；但这个具体礼物恢复方式没有被确认成通用配方。
notes.use: The animal-care and NPC relationship guidance can explain why a seller's purchase tab disappears: check the heart color, stop spamming gifts, and use the relevant NPC's preferences rather than guessing from one crop. Keep the red-heart recovery report labeled as a player observation.
notes.zhUse: 动物照料和 NPC 关系说明可以解释商人的购买页为什么消失：先看心形颜色，停止连续送礼，再按对应 NPC 的喜好选择礼物，不要从某一种作物推导所有 NPC。红心恢复步骤继续标为玩家实测。
notes.risk: The thread does not provide a complete preference table, an exact cooldown or a current build number. It also does not prove that the same plant-based gift works for every seller or that animal slaughter caused the purple hearts; the author's latter explanation is unverified.
notes.zhRisk: 讨论没有给出完整喜好表、精确冷却时间或当前构建号，也不能证明同一种植物礼物对所有商人都有效，更不能把玩家猜测的“宰杀 NPC 动物导致紫心”当成已证实原因。

notes.name: Chicken starvation warning and water trough checks
notes.zhName: 鸡挨饿警告与水槽排查
notes.build: Early Access discussion; exact patch not stated
notes.scope: When chickens appear starving despite hay being present, moderator Jennoula recommends hand-feeding the affected animals as a short-term precaution, adding water to the coop trough, and checking sickness plus the number of animals linked to the coop door. The answer does not give a feed quantity or establish a universal death timer.
notes.zhScope: 当鸡舍里有干草但鸡仍显示挨饿时，版主 Jennoula 建议先手动喂食受影响的动物作为短期保险，把水加到鸡舍水槽，并检查生病状态和鸡舍门显示的关联动物数量。答复没有给出饲料消耗量，也没有证明存在通用死亡倒计时。
notes.use: Add this as a compact troubleshooting branch in the animal-care guide: verify water first, then sickness and coop linkage, with hand-feeding only as a temporary safeguard. Keep the player's later claim about animals dying despite eating as an unverified report rather than a rule.
notes.zhUse: 在动物照料攻略中增加一个简短排障分支：先确认水槽，再查生病和鸡舍关联数量，手动喂食只作为临时保险。发帖者后来声称“明明吃了仍死亡”仍是未验证报告，不能写成规则。
notes.risk: The thread has no current build number and covers one player's coop state. It does not prove that every starvation warning is a water bug, nor that the same checks apply identically to every species or building.
notes.zhRisk: 讨论没有当前构建号，而且只覆盖一个玩家的鸡舍状态。它不能证明所有挨饿警告都是缺水 Bug，也不能证明每个物种或建筑都完全适用同一套排查。

notes.name: Passing out and the day counter
notes.zhName: 昏倒与日期计数
notes.build: Early Access discussion; exact patch not stated
notes.scope: Moderator Jennoula explains that when the clock has passed midnight, sleeping or passing out advances the date again on wake-up: the day that began before midnight becomes the next day after midnight, then the following day after sleep/pass-out. The moderator says the game does not make this clear and the behavior was flagged for review.
notes.zhScope: 版主 Jennoula 说明：当时钟已经过午夜，睡觉或昏倒后醒来会再次推进日期；午夜前开始的那一天过午夜后成为下一天，睡觉/昏倒后再进入后一天。版主表示游戏没有把这一点讲清楚，并已标记复核。
notes.use: Add a clear calendar warning to the farming and beginner guides: stop before midnight when a crop deadline matters, and distinguish a normal sleep from a post-midnight sleep/pass-out. Do not use the thread to infer crop growth timing or universal crop-loss behavior.
notes.zhUse: 在种田和新手指南中增加日历提醒：涉及作物截止日期时尽量在午夜前停下，并区分正常睡觉和过午夜后睡觉/昏倒。不能用这篇讨论推导作物生长时间或通用作物丢失机制。
notes.risk: The thread does not state a current build number and contains a separate unresolved crop-growth report. Only the date-counter explanation is treated as an official answer; the crop-loss symptom remains unverified.
notes.zhRisk: 讨论没有当前构建号，且还包含一个未解决的作物生长报告。这里只采纳日期计数说明，作物丢失症状仍未验证。

notes.zhRisk: 页面包含旧的 0.8.10.455 与 0.8.10.562 引用，而且没有标明当前补丁。后续修复（包括 0.8.10.858 的建造和动物改动）可能使其中的数字与跑图说法过时。

notes.name: ranchers.wiki guide hub
notes.zhName: ranchers.wiki 攻略总览
notes.build: Mixed-era guide hub; a September 2026 update lead is present
notes.scope: A broad guide index covering farming, animals, building, co-op, crafting, exploration and money. The hub is not an official source, does not provide a single build boundary for all pages, and its homepage plus release/platform page still show pre-launch or unsupported copy such as 'out now on all platforms', an unconfirmed ~$39.99 price, and an old Coming Soon state. The money page is especially unsafe for current systems because its own source list is only Steam and the promotional site; even where its patch article matches the official bullets, its extra explanation is not evidence.

notes.scope: The developer's September 2026 FAQ lists working as a taxi driver as an earning activity. A player report adds that hiring the taxi has a fixed daily cost, but neither source provides a fare, route count or net-income measurement.
notes.zhScope: 开发商 2026 年 9 月 FAQ 把出租车驾驶列为赚钱方式。一条玩家报告补充租车有固定日成本，但两份资料都没有提供车费、路线数量或净收益测量。
notes.use: The money guide uses the FAQ to confirm that taxi work belongs in the activity list, then exposes the player report only as a measurement candidate: record the daily rental fee, fares, active minutes and settlement line twice before comparing it with crops, foraging or direct selling.
notes.zhUse: 赚钱指南用 FAQ 确认出租车应列入活动清单，再把玩家报告仅作为待测候选：至少记录两次日租、车费、主动分钟和结算行，再与作物、采集或直接出售比较。
notes.risk: The FAQ does not provide a build-specific fare or payout, and the player report is unversioned. Do not call taxi driving profitable, stable or better than farming until a current-build reproduction exists.
notes.zhRisk: FAQ 没有给出当前构建的车费或结算，玩家报告也没有版本号。在当前版本复现前，不把出租车称为已验证、有稳定收益或优于种田。

kind.zh: 有证据边界的社区攻略

notes.name: Daily orders guide
notes.zhName: 每日订单攻略
notes.build: Community guide; exact patch not stated
notes.scope: The guide asks players to record the live order's item, deadline, delivery details and reward, and intentionally avoids fixed values because availability and terms change.
notes.zhScope: 攻略要求玩家记录当前订单的物品、期限、交付信息和奖励，并因可用性与条件会变化而刻意不提供固定数值。
notes.use: We use it to expose a task-and-economy question path: preserve restart supplies, separate requested goods from sale stock, and measure one order before ranking it. No order value is copied into the database.
notes.zhUse: 本站用它补充任务与经济问题入口：先保留重启生产所需物资，把订单物品和出售库存分开，再测一条订单后比较。不把订单金额复制进数据库。
notes.risk: It is a community planning guide, not an official order table, and it has no exact patch marker. Item names, deadlines and rewards still need a current-build screenshot or record.
notes.zhRisk: 这是社区规划攻略，不是官方订单表，也没有精确补丁标记。物品名称、期限和奖励仍需当前版本截图或记录。

kind.zh: 有证据边界的任务攻略

notes.name: Early quests guide
notes.zhName: 早期任务攻略
notes.sourceTitle: The Ranchers Early Quests Guide: Turn Objectives Into Ranch
notes.build: Community guide; exact patch not stated
notes.scope: A question-first guide that deliberately avoids inventing a fixed quest chain, reward list or coordinate table. It asks players to copy the live objective, separate the requested item or action from assumptions, record blocked requirements and review the inventory after the objective changes.
notes.zhScope: 一篇问题优先的任务攻略，刻意不编造固定任务链、奖励表或坐标表。它要求玩家抄下当前目标，把要求的物品或动作与猜测分开，记录卡住的条件，并在目标变化后复核库存。
notes.use: We use this as a UX and test-protocol reference for the quest database and tracker: capture the exact objective before routing, preserve requested materials, and treat an unavailable step as evidence to record rather than a reason to invent an unlock.
notes.zhUse: 本站把它作为任务数据库和追踪器的界面与测试流程参考：规划路线前先记录精确目标，保留任务物资，把暂不可用的步骤记录为证据，而不是自行编造解锁条件。
notes.risk: It is a community planning guide with no current patch marker and no direct proof of any individual quest condition. Its workflow can improve recording, but it does not validate local objective text, rewards, locations or progression order.
notes.zhRisk: 这是没有当前补丁标记的社区规划攻略，也没有直接证明任何单个任务条件。它能改善记录流程，但不能验证本站的目标文本、奖励、地点或进度顺序。

notes.name: the-ranchers.com independent site
notes.zhName: the-ranchers.com 独立站
notes.sourceTitle: The Ranchers — Open World Country-Life Sim
notes.build: Independent marketing site; stale release copy
notes.scope: An independent site that presents a long-form overview, gallery and FAQ, but still announces March 20, 2026, describes Early Access as a future Q2 event, and repeats auction, companion-app, mining, combat, wildlife, hunting and family claims. Its own disclaimer says it is not affiliated with the developer or publisher.
notes.zhScope: 一个提供长篇介绍、画廊和 FAQ 的独立站，但仍宣布 2026 年 3 月 20 日发售，把抢先体验写成未来的 Q2 事件，并重复拍卖、伴侣应用、采矿、战斗、野生动物、狩猎和家庭等说法。页面自己的免责声明也说明它与开发商和发行商没有关系。
notes.use: We record it as a negative search audit so players who find its polished SEO copy are routed to current Steam updates and the evidence method. No release date, platform, price, recipe, coordinate, mobile feature or planned system is copied into the database.
notes.zhUse: 本站把它记录为负面搜索审计，让通过精致 SEO 文案找到它的玩家回到当前 Steam 更新和证据方法。不把发售日期、平台、价格、配方、坐标、移动端功能或规划系统复制进数据库。
notes.risk: The page has no current build marker or primary citations and contradicts the live Early Access timeline. Its repeated feature paragraphs read as promotional or generated copy, so they cannot establish current availability or mechanics.
notes.zhRisk: 页面没有当前版本标记或一手引用，而且与实际抢先体验时间线冲突。重复的功能段落更像宣传或生成式文案，不能证明当前可用性或玩法机制。

notes.name: Official website and Press Kit
notes.zhName: 官方游戏官网与 Press Kit
notes.sourceTitle: The Ranchers official website and Press Kit
notes.build: Promotional site; no current Early Access build marker
notes.scope: The official homepage describes the game's broad concept and planned-looking systems such as online co-op, an auction market, a companion app, mines, shipwrecks, monsters, hunting and family features. The separate Press Kit is an artwork, logo and contact page, not a gameplay database or patch record.
notes.zhScope: 官方首页介绍游戏的大方向，并提到线上联机、拍卖市场、伴侣应用、矿洞、沉船、怪物、狩猎和家庭等看起来像规划或宣传范围的系统。单独的 Press Kit 只有美术、Logo 和联系信息，不是玩法数据库或补丁记录。
notes.use: We use the site only for official naming, search aliases and historical feature-boundary checks. Current availability, prices, recipes, coordinates, mobile support and economy rules must come from dated Steam announcements, owned-build records or reproducible tests; no gameplay rows are imported from the homepage or Press Kit.
notes.zhUse: 本站只用它核对官方名称、搜索别名和历史功能边界。当前可用性、价格、配方、坐标、移动端支持与经济规则必须来自带日期的 Steam 公告、本地游戏文件或可复现实测；不从首页或 Press Kit 导入玩法数据。
notes.risk: The site is promotional and does not separate current Early Access features from older plans. Its auction, companion-app, mining, combat, wildlife, hunting and family wording can conflict with the current Steam Early Access boundary, so a marketing claim is not proof of a live system.
notes.zhRisk: 该站是宣传站，没有把当前抢先体验功能与旧规划分开。拍卖、伴侣应用、采矿、战斗、野生动物、狩猎和家庭等文案可能与当前 Steam 抢先体验边界冲突，因此宣传说法不能证明系统已经上线。

notes.name: GameFAQs directory and release data
notes.zhName: GameFAQs 目录与发售数据
notes.build: Conflicting directory metadata; release row says 2026-07-30, developer labels disagree
notes.scope: GameFAQs now has a PC release-details page with a July 30, 2026 Steam release row, publisher and AppID 1501310. The same directory repeats title data with conflicting developer labels (The Ranchers and WildPixel Games), while Cheats, Guides and Questions remain empty; it is a metadata/search entry, not a current gameplay encyclopedia.
notes.zhScope: GameFAQs 现在有 PC 发售详情页，列出 2026 年 7 月 30 日 Steam 发售、发行商和 AppID 1501310；但同一目录重复了开发商为 The Ranchers 与 WildPixel Games 的冲突条目，秘籍、攻略和问题入口仍为空。因此它只是元数据/搜索入口，不是当前玩法百科。
notes.use: We use it to catch players searching GameFAQs for cheats, guides or release details, then route them back to the current database, troubleshooting pages and official Steam updates. We retain the release row only as a cross-check and do not copy the conflicting developer labels, cheats, release marketing or gameplay rules.
notes.zhUse: 本站用它覆盖会在 GameFAQs 搜索秘籍、攻略或发售资料的玩家，再把他们引回当前数据库、排障页和 Steam 官方更新。发售行只用于交叉核对，不复制冲突的开发商标签、秘籍、发售宣传或玩法规则。
notes.risk: The directory is internally inconsistent and has no current patch marker, guides, questions or reproducible data. Its duplicate developer labels conflict with official Steam identity, so treat the page as a discovery and metadata warning rather than authority.
notes.zhRisk: 该目录内部不一致，没有当前补丁标记、攻略、问题或可复现数据。重复的开发商标签与 Steam 官方身份冲突，只能作为搜索和元数据警示，不能当权威资料。

notes.name: Metacritic — The Ranchers
notes.zhName: Metacritic《The Ranchers》
notes.build: Review directory; no critic or user reviews listed
notes.scope: Metacritic has a PC/Virtual Life directory entry for The Ranchers, but it currently lists no critic reviews, no user reviews and no score. It is useful as a review-search alias and coverage check, not as a gameplay encyclopedia or quality verdict.
notes.zhScope: Metacritic 有《The Ranchers》的 PC/Virtual Life 目录条目，但当前没有媒体评测、用户评测或分数。它只适合覆盖评测搜索入口和目录状态，不能当玩法百科，也不能把空评分解释成质量结论。
notes.use: We keep the page as a neutral review-directory pointer and send players to the dated Steam review snapshot or official updates for current feedback. No score, review sentiment, feature, price or gameplay rule is copied.
notes.zhUse: 本站只把它作为中立的评测目录入口，并把玩家引向带日期的 Steam 评测快照或官方更新。不复制分数、评测情绪、功能、价格或玩法规则。
notes.risk: An empty Metascore or user score means that the directory has no listed reviews at the time of checking; it does not mean the game is good, bad or unreviewed everywhere. The page has no current-build gameplay evidence.
notes.zhRisk: Metascore 或用户分数为空，只说明检查时目录没有列出评测，不代表游戏好坏，也不代表全网没有评测。页面没有当前版本玩法证据。
